offers.title: The Aether Goblins
offers.bane: Monsters now have greatly increased health
offers.boon: Aether Events can spawn Aether Goblins

offers.title: The Aether Rush
offers.boon: Gathering Aether Increases movement speed (8 seconds)

offers.title: The Anchored Masses
offers.bane: Masses have greatly increased attack speed
offers.boon: Masses have a chance to spawn a Soulspire on death

offers.title: The Chaotic Offering
offers.bane: Start a random Chaos Wave which grants bonus Aether

offers.title: The Colossal Fiends
offers.bane: Aether Lords cause Hellfire to erupt around them
offers.boon: Aether Fiends spawn as Aether Lords and drop 3x Aether

offers.title: The Hungry Spires
offers.bane: Soulspires pull both enemies and players towards them
offers.boon: Enemies killed in range of Soulspires have a chance to drop Aether

offers.title: The Desolate Verge
offers.bane: Soulspires spawn more often Masses spawn less often

offers.title: The Exalted Fiends
offers.bane: Aether Fiends have greatly increased health

offers.title: The Enduring Lords
offers.bane: Aether Lords health is greatly increased
offers.boon: Aether Lords no longer despawn at round end

offers.title: The Fiendish Legions
offers.bane: Elite and Aether Fiend damage increased
offers.boon: Aether Fiends have a chance to spawn in place of Elites

offers.title: The Fiendish Masses
offers.bane: Masses spawn an Aether Fiend on death

offers.title: The Fiendish Spires
offers.bane: Soulspires spawn an Aether fiend on death

offers.title: 100% Chaos Waves
offers.bane: Force ALL waves to be Chaos Waves

offers.title: 100% Next Chaos Wave Offering
offers.bane: Force next offering to have a Chaos Wave

offers.title: No Chaos Waves
offers.bane: Turn off all access to Chaos Waves

offers.title: The Teeming Masses
offers.boon: Masses have a chance to spawn an Aether Fiend on death

offers.title: The Gorging Mass
offers.boon: +25% chance to spawn another mass on death

offers.title: The Hellish Masses
offers.boon: Masses have a chance to spawn Hellborne on death

offers.title: The Wrath of Hell
offers.boon: At the end of each wave spawn 15-24 additional Aether

offers.title: The Stalking Devil
offers.bane: A demon of great power has your scent

offers.title: The Massing Masses
offers.boon: Masses have a chance to reform on death

offers.title: The Precious Mass
offers.boon: +25% chance to spawn a Soulspire on death

offers.title: The Puffing Masses
offers.boon: Masses drop +1 Aether per Offering, doubled for Mass Offerings

offers.title: The Burning Rain
offers.boon: At the end of each wave spawn 9-15 Aether

offers.title: The Ruthless Lords
offers.bane: Aether Lords gain health and damage for each spawn

offers.title: The Bartuc Portal
offers.bane: Invoke to face Bartuc, Lord of Chaos

offers.title: The Council Portal
offers.bane: Invoke to face the Council Members

offers.title: The Summoned Hellborne
offers.bane: Hellborne can now spawn with Aether Events

offers.title: The Bursting Masses
offers.boon: Wave start, spawn two Aetheric Masses

chests.name: Spoils of Gold
chests.detail: Exchange all remaining Aether for Gold

chests.name: Spoils of Materials
chests.detail: Exchange all remaining Aether for Obducite and Gem fragments.

chests.name: Spoils of Experience
chests.detail: Exchange all remaining Aether for Experience
